acceptanceCriteria: Shell test units can declare bounded read scopes (or `go env` is modelled as a bounded toolchain read)
unbounded-readers-check refuses an undeclared read as before
body: The tests-reliability lane (2026-10-21) had to add script/check-sql-native-ratchets_test.sh to .corvint/unbounded-readers.json only because it runs `go env` to pin the host toolchain. Go packages can declare bounded read scopes in .corvint/test-read-scopes.json, but shell units cannot. Any shell test that queries the toolchain therefore widens affected selection to every change.
title: A shell test unit cannot declare read scopes, so any shell test that runs `go env` is classed as an unbounded reader
